style.styleTitle: Hallmark Star Wars AT-AT Walker Christmas Bauble
style.toneOfVoice: Blast into the celebrations and make any occasion awesome with this exciting Star Wars AT-AT Walker Keepsake hanging ornament. Display it on your Christmas tree or as part of your Star Wars collection all year round. This iconic ornament is made from metal and features Imperial AT-AT Walker from Star Wars. Simply add a loop of twine, ribbon or thread (not included) to the metal ring to hang and display this collectible keepsake in your home. It s the perfect Christmas tree decoration or gift for Star Wars fans. Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Ornament Measures: H9.1cm x W9.5cm x D2cm This is not a toy. For decorative use only. Dimensions(mm): Height: 91 Width: 95 Depth: 20.
